SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, fully_loaded
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND fiscal_period IN (9,10)
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 9 AS first_period, 10 AS last_period
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS click_collect_net,
       SUM(l.net_sales) AS web_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 2) AS share,
       COUNT(*) AS n
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
l AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(net_sales) AS mine FROM l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10) GROUP BY 1
),
ctrl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(c.net_sales) AS ctrl FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=c.business_date
    WHERE c.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10) GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.fiscal_period, m.mine, c.ctrl, m.mine - c.ctrl AS gap,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM fact_web_order) AS dup_orders,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line) AS dup_lines,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line) AS dup_returns
FROM mine m JOIN ctrl c USING (fiscal_period) ORDER BY 1
